2124699619493892114.en_summary: And I forgot to mention that our employees are the largest investors in the funds we manage, further aligning our interest with our investors. Our employees' investment in our funds represents approximately $6 billion of our ~$25 billion of fee-paying assets and we purchased approximately $600 million of our recent $PSUS IPO. This is the largest commitment of capital as a percentage of funds managed of any of the alts and one of the largest dollar amounts invested by employees, which is particularly notable in light of how small our employee base is at less than 1% of the number of Blackstone employees.

2124698401178837126.en_summary: You got some things right and other things wrong, but in general, your overall construct is incorrect. It is not the case that the other alts contributed all of their performance fees to their public companies, and that our shareholders don't benefit from the investment performance generated by our funds. It is true that Pershing Square Inc. ($PS) is structured differently from the other alternative asset managers (alts) like Blackstone, KKR, and others. Our unique structure is highly beneficial to our company and our shareholders. In short, when Blackstone and the other alts went public, they contributed a substantial portion -- typically 40% to 60%, but not all of their incentive, performance, or promote compensation to the public company and retained the balance to compensate their employees. The outcome of this approach has been suboptimal.
2124698401178837126.zh_summary: 你有些地方對，有些地方錯，但總體上你的整體構建是不正確的。並非其他另類投資將所有績效費用貢獻給了他們的上市公司，而我們的股東沒有從我們基金產生的投資績效中受益。確實，Pershing Square Inc. ($PS) 的結構與黑石、KKR 等其他另類資產管理公司不同。我們獨特的結構對我們公司和股東高度有益。簡而言之，當黑石和其他另類投資上市時，他們將相當大的一部分——通常是 40% 到 60%，但不是全部的激勵、績效或促進補償貢獻給上市公司，並保留餘額以補償員工。這種方法的結果是次優的。
